title: Viral video raises worry over Sinclair's political messaging inside local news
summary: A PBS NewsHour report on a viral compilation of local TV anchors reading identical scripts, which raised concerns about Sinclair Broadcasting mixing partisan opinion into local news. It also covers Sinclair's reach and its bid to grow larger.
why: Cited as a short, concrete example of consolidated media ownership pushing coordinated messaging through local news.
